createUpstream.title: Create Upstream Branch?
createUpstream.description: Branch {{branch}} has no upstream. Push it to a remote branch with the same name and track it for future pushes and pulls?
createUpstream.noRemotes: No remotes configured. Add one using Manage Remotes before pushing.

pull.title: Reconcile divergent branches
pull.description: Your branch “{{branch}}” and its remote both have new commits. Choose how to combine them.
pull.mergeExplanation: Keep your existing commits and create a merge commit joining both histories.
pull.rebaseExplanation: Replay your local commits on top of the remote branch. This rewrites local commits and changes their IDs. Avoid rebasing commits you have already shared.
pull.once: This choice applies only to this pull. Your Git settings will not change. Cancel leaves your commits untouched.
pull.conflict: Pull stopped. Resolve conflicts in Changes, then continue or abort.
